emma carter: FYI - customer reported seeing a few lines in their console that belonged to another org after they did several fast org switches. looks like multi-tenant leak in UI again.

rajiv menon: can you repro locally? which branch/cluster was that on?

emma carter: repro on canary-9, branch routing/affinity-prefetch-2. steps: login org-apple -> switch to org-banana -> switch back to org-apple quickly. alert panel sometimes contains 1-2 items from org-banana.

noah kim: my initial suspicion: queued work serializes header blob into job metadata. when job runs later, the worker uses that stale header instead of resolving session. leads to mixed rows and bad quota attribution.

emma carter: i captured a trace:
```
[2025-11-12T07:22:10Z] ui: org switch to org-banana user=u-77
[2025-11-12T07:22:10Z] enqueue job=jb-a12 headers={"x-org":"org-apple","cookie":"sess-77"}
[2025-11-12T07:22:11Z] session rotated -> sess-78 org=org-banana
[2025-11-12T07:22:12Z] worker jb-a12 executes with headers.x-org=org-apple -> returns alerts(org-apple)
[2025-11-12T07:22:12Z] UI merges alerts into current list (header shows org-banana) -> mixed tenant rows
```

rajiv menon: ugh. that also means billing could wrongly attribute tokens to the wrong tenant if background fetches generate usage.

noah kim: quick mitigation options:
- don't serialize tenant-identifying headers into job payloads; store only session id and re-resolve at run time.
- at job start, compare serialized header org vs sessionService.resolve(session).org; if mismatch, re-resolve and fetch with the current org (and emit telemetry).

emma carter: second option seems lowest blast radius for this week. we can ship a feature-flagged check that re-resolves on mismatch and continues. also emit telemetry counter `queue_org_mismatch` with tags `expected` and `resolved`.

rajiv menon: agreed. i'll draft a small patch: add validation to worker startup path, feature flag `worker_resolve_org_on_start` default on for canary, and unit+integration tests that simulate session rotation. also add a migration step to scan queued jobs with header blobs and re-enqueue if older than 24h.

noah kim: add e2e quick-switch loop (1000 iterations) as a gate for merge. also add an alert: `queue_org_mismatch.rate > 1/min` -> page eng-platform.

ci-bot: CI queued: unit(18) integration(5) smoke(1).

deploy-bot: Deploying patch branch fix/worker-resolve-org to canary-9 (10% traffic).

emma carter: ran local smoke 500x, zero cross-tenant rows. logging shows the telemetry counter firing twice during the initial canary runs (expected from old queued blobs). i've saved the trace ids to the incident ticket.

rajiv menon: PR opened #4872 with tests + rollout notes + revert steps. tagging ops for memory watch during canary - last worker change bumped resident set on worker-2.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #4872.

deploy-bot: Deployed fix/worker-resolve-org to canary-9 at 2025-11-12T08:03:30Z :white_check_mark:

emma carter: monitoring telemetry - mismatch rate dropped to 0 after requeue job sweep. closing the thread. thanks folks. :tada:
